data.gender_notes: Gwenette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Welsh name Gwenhwyfar, meaning 'fair one, white, or pure'. In Arthurian legend, Gwenhwyfar was the wife of King Arthur and was renowned for her great beauty. The name gained popularity in England during the Middle Ages. The name Gwenette carries the meaning “Fair one, white, pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gwenette usually hope their child will grow to embody fair one, white, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gwenette total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
